associations.title: Valider les filtres allié, ennemi, neutre et soi-même
associations.finding: Heal selects owner plus one living ally;Ezreal W handles allied/enemy champions and arms self contact separately;Ezreal Q filters enemy/neutral eligible actors. These are concrete per-spell filters,not one universal interpretation of native flags.
associations.remaining: Qualify all spells,ally/enemy/neutral/self predicates,visibility and original exceptions. Raw Flags/TextFlags do not prove the server policy.

associations.title: Valider les cibles champion, sbire, monstre, structure et invocation

associations.remaining: Qualify full type matrix,all summons and structure exceptions for every ability;support exclusions are not evidence of native immunity.

associations.title: Résoudre les intersections des zones circulaires
associations.finding: Tibbers summon/aura select targets with center distance <= zone radius + target body radius;structure protection and team/life filters apply. Native CastRadius supplies a scalar;closed-circle geometry is current reconstruction.
associations.remaining: Qualify complete circular-zone families,body radii,boundaries,terrain/height and native timing/order;do not infer all circle behavior from Tibbers.

associations.title: Résoudre les intersections des cônes
associations.finding: Annie W calls a finite closed-sector/circle intersection helper;native CastConeAngle is consumed as current half_angle,range625. Helper checks finite inputs,unit direction,caps and rays;the interpretation is explicitly reconstructed.
associations.remaining: Qualify angle interpretation,all cone abilities,radius defaults,moving targets,precision and original hit order.

associations.title: Résoudre les intersections des lignes et projectiles
associations.finding: linear_skillshot contact_distance computes earliest closed segment/circle contact using the original ray and f64 predicates;Ezreal Q advances this current helper against fixed centers per tick. No terrain/continuous moving-target or original server geometry qualification.
associations.remaining: Qualify continuous target motion,terrain,3D heights,precision/boundaries and every line ability. Q primary width80 and display range1150 differ from chosen radius60/range1200.

associations.title: Appliquer les limites de portée au lancement
associations.finding: Garen R validates champion center range;Trundle E validates a ground center and terrain;Tibbers validates ground point range. Directional casts separate input aim point from traveled distance. There is no universal range formula.
associations.remaining: Qualify center/bounding-box/edge conventions,clamping vs rejection,range overrides and all spell-specific behavior.

associations.title: Résoudre les collisions et cibles multiples des projectiles
associations.finding: Shot orders contacts by distance then entity ID,remembers hits and supports FirstContact/Pierce. Q uses first contact;R pierces and increments attenuation count after accepted damage. These deterministic local choices are not the native server callback order.
associations.remaining: Qualify all collision shapes,target motion/multiplicity,terrain,bounces,returning missiles,failed-contact policy and native tie order.

associations.title: Appliquer une seule fois les effets d’un événement rejoué
associations.finding: Resumable input checks authenticated sequence before commit;host commits then dispatches game.command. Shot rejects repeated/skipped ticks and remembers hit IDs. These prevent selected replays locally,not a universal exactly-once guarantee across all events or crashes.
associations.remaining: Qualify all replay paths,legacy inputs,persistence/restarts,session boundaries and side effects;no native deduplication protocol is inferred from local transport.

associations.title: Gérer les déplacements forcés bloqués par un obstacle
associations.finding: Trundle E preflights the complete push segment against terrain/other pillars and rechecks each movement step. Blocked motion does not teleport through the obstacle;late intrusion is separately retried. This remains point-agent geometry without actor footprint parity.
associations.remaining: Qualify all forced movement,actor footprints,wall interactions,landing selection,interrupt ordering and original obstacle collision semantics.

garenE/Description.text: Garen performs a dance of death with his sword, dealing damage around him for the duration.

garenE/DynamicTooltip.text:
Judgment (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]No Cost@Cooldown@ sec CooldownGaren rapidly spins his sword around his body for @Effect2Amount@ seconds, dealing @Effect1Amount@ plus @Effect3Amount@% of his attack (+@f1@) as physical damage to nearby enemies every second. Garen can move through units while spinning but moves 20% slower when travelling through minions and monsters.

Judgment can critically strike dealing bonus damage.
Judgment deals 25% less damage to minions.

garenR/Description.text: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to deal a finishing blow to an enemy champion that deals damage based upon how much Health his target has missing.

garenR/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Demacian Justice (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>No Cost</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion, dealing @Effect1Amount@ magic damage plus 1 damage for every @Effect2Amount@ Health the target is missing.</mainText>

annieW/Description.text: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

annieW/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Incinerate</titleLeft><titleRight>Level @Level@ [@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Casts a cone of fire dealing @Effect1Amount@ <font color='#99FF99'>(+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> magic damage to all enemies in the area.</mainText>

annieR/Description.text: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

annieR/DynamicTooltip.text:
Summon: TibbersLevel @Level@ [@Hotkey@]@Cost@ Mana@Cooldown@ sec CooldownTibbers appears in a burst of flame dealing @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharAbilityPower@) magic damage to enemies in the target area.

For the next @Effect6Amount@ seconds, Tibbers chases down enemies and deals @Effect4Amount@ (+@CharAbilityPower2@) magic damage each second to nearby foes.

Tibbers can be controlled by holding the alt key and using the right mouse button or by reactivating this ability.

ezrealQ/Description.text: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns by 1 second if it strikes an enemy unit.

ezrealQ/DynamicTooltip.text:
Mystic Shot (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]@Cost@ Mana@Cooldown@ sec CooldownEzreal fires a bolt of energy, dealing @Effect1Amount@ (+@f3@) (+@CharAbilityPower2@) physical damage (applies on-hit effects).

Ezreal's cooldowns are reduced by 1 second if Mystic Shot hits a target.

ezrealW/Description.text: Ezreal fires a fluctuating wave of energy, dealing magic damage to enemy champions, while increasing the Attack Speed of allied champions.

ezrealW/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Essence Flux (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Ezreal fires a wave of energy that damages all enemy champions it passes through for @Effect1Amount@ <font color='#99FF99'>(+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> magic damage. If Ezreal or his Allied champions are hit by the wave, their Attack Speed is increased by @Effect2Amount@% for 5 seconds.</mainText>

ezrealR/Description.text: Ezreal channels for 1 second to fire a powerful barrage of energy missiles which do massive damage to each unit they pass through (deals 10% less damage to each unit it passes through).

ezrealR/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Trueshot Barrage (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Ezreal channels for 1 second to fire a barrage of missiles dealing @Effect1Amount@ <font color='#FF8C00'>(+@f1@)</font> <font color='#99FF99'>(+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> magic damage to each unit it passes through. However, it deals @Effect2Amount@% less damage for each unit it hits (minimum @Effect3Amount@%).</mainText>

trundleE/Description.text: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

trundleE/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Pillar of Ice (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Trundle creates an icy pillar at target location for @Effect1Amount@ seconds, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units by @Effect2Amount@%.</mainText>

charges/Description.text: Teemo places an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time.

charges/DynamicTooltip.text:
Noxious Trap (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]@Cost@ Mana@Cooldown@ sec CooldownUses a stored mushroom to place a trap that detonates if an enemy steps on it, spreading poison to nearby enemies that slows Movement Speed by @Effect2Amount@% and deals @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharAbilityPower@) magic damage over 4 seconds. Traps last @Effect5Amount@ minutes.

Teemo forages for a mushroom every @f1@ seconds, but he is only big enough to carry 3 at once.

channel/Description.text: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers with unrivaled speed at up to three nearby Champions. Daggers deal magic damage and reduce incoming healing on targets hit.

channel/DynamicTooltip.text:
Death Lotus (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]No Cost@Cooldown@ sec CooldownBecomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers at the closest 3 enemy Champions dealing @Effect1Amount*10@ (+@CharBonusPhysical2@) (+@CharAbilityPower@) magic damage over @Effect3Amount@ seconds.

Daggers apply Grievous Wounds, reducing incoming healing by 50% for 3 seconds.

heal/Description.text: Restores 90-345 Health (depending on champion level) and grants 30% Movement Speed for 1 second to you and target allied champion. This healing is halved for units recently affected by Summoner Heal.

heal/DynamicTooltip.text:
Heal [@Hotkey@]No Cost@f3@ second CooldownRestores @f1@ Health and grants 30% Movement Speed for 1 second to your champion and target allied champion. This healing is halved for units recently affected by Summoner Heal.

If this spell cannot find a target, it will cast on the most wounded allied champion in range.

smite/Description.text: Deals 390-1000 true damage (depending on champion level) to target epic or large monster or enemy minion.

smite/DynamicTooltip.text:
Smite[@Hotkey@]No Cost@f2@ second CooldownDeals @f1@ true damage to target epic or large monster or enemy minion.

Smiting Large Monsters instantly harvests additional bonuses based on the Monster. Mouse over large jungle monsters to see potential bonus rewards.
